name: network-quota-guardian
description: Monitors VPC, ELB, Global Accelerator, and VPN service quotas across all active regions - EIPs, VPCs, security groups, ENIs, rules-per-SG, NAT gateways, managed-prefix-list capacity and effective-rule consumption, ELB count, Global Accelerator accelerators, and VPN connections - and flags any at 80 percent or higher with a recommended increase value. Read-only and recommend-only; describes an opt-in, human-approved auto-file directed action for quota increases in prose but never files one itself. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 06:30 UTC
